lines.text: پیشین در مذهب جلیل القدر تا انزمانست که ظل مقیاس مساوی مقیاس شود وسوی فی
lines.en: The earlier [prayer] in the glorious sect is until the time when the shadow of the gnomon becomes equal to the gnomon, and the shadow of the sun at noon

lines.text: زوال وفضیلت عصر تا انمقدار که دو برابر مقیاس شود وسوی فی زوال واول وقت نماز
lines.en: and the merit of the afternoon [prayer] is until the amount that it becomes twice the gnomon, and the shadow of the sun at noon, and the beginning of the time of the prayer

lines.text: شام بعد از استیفای غروب تمام جرم افتاب واول نماز خفتن بعد از غروب شفق است
lines.en: of the evening is after the completion of the setting of the entire body of the sun, and the beginning of the night prayer is after the setting of the twilight.

lines.text: واین هر دو بمذهب طایفه سنیه است اما بمذهب جمهور فرقه ناجیه امامیه اول وقت نماز شام
lines.en: And these two are according to the sect of the Sunni group, but according to the majority of the saved Imami sect, the beginning of the time of the evening prayer

lines.text: از زمان ذهاب حمره مشرقیه است تا انمقدار که فرض مغرب ادا شود بعد از انوقت خفتن
lines.en: is from the time of the disappearance of the eastern redness until the amount that the obligation of the evening [prayer] is performed, after that time the night [prayer]

lines.text: در اید و هر دو وقت مشترک گردد تا انزمان که بنصف شب مقدار ادای فریضه خفتن باشد
lines.en: enters, and both times become shared until the time when at midnight the amount of performing the obligation of the night [prayer] remains,

lines.text: پس از انوقت تا نصف شب مخصوص خفتن باشد اما فضیلت وقت شام تا زمان رفتن
lines.en: then from that time until midnight is specific to the night [prayer], but the merit of the time of the evening [prayer] is until the time of the departure

lines.text: روشنی است از جانب مغرب وفضیلت وقت نماز خفتن تا انقضای یکدانگ ونیمست از
lines.en: of the light from the western side, and the merit of the time of the night prayer is until the expiration of one and a half dang of

lines.text: شب و دو دانگ نیز گفته اند اما ارتفاع سمت قبله عبارت از رسیدن افتابست بارتفاعی که
lines.en: the night, and two dangs have also been said, but the altitude of the azimuth of the Qibla is the expression of the sun reaching an altitude that

lines.text: در آن ارتفاع ظل مقیاس سامت مکه باشد چون دایره عظیمه فرض کنند که سمت الراس مکه
lines.en: at that altitude the shadow of the gnomon is aligned with Mecca, since they assume a great circle that the zenith of Mecca

lines.text: وسمت الراس بلد مفروض گذرد تقاطع ایندایره بافق این بلد ان نقاطی که در جهه مکه بود
lines.en: and the zenith of the assumed city passes through, the intersection of this circle with the horizon of this city, those points that are in the direction of Mecca

lines.text: نقطه سمت قبله بود نسبت باین بلد وفصل مشترک میان سطح افق وسطح ایندایره را خط سمت
lines.en: will be the point of the azimuth of the Qibla relative to this city, and the common intersection between the plane of the horizon and the plane of this circle is the line of the azimuth

lines.text: قبله گویند پس چون افتاب باین دایره رسد قوسی از ایندایره که واقع باشد میان مرکز
lines.en: of the Qibla they say, so when the sun reaches this circle, an arc of this circle that is located between the center

lines.text: افتاب وافق بشرطیکه از ربع زیاده نباشد ارتفاع سمت قبله بود وچون در انوقت سهم مقیاس
lines.en: of the sun and the horizon, provided that it is not more than a quadrant, will be the altitude of the azimuth of the Qibla, and since at that time the arrow of the gnomon

lines.text: ومرکز افتاب هر دو داخل سطح ایندایره اند لا محاله منتصف ظل مقیاس نیز داخل در ان سطح
lines.en: and the center of the sun are both inside the plane of this circle, inevitably the middle of the shadow of the gnomon is also inside that plane.

lines.text: بود کما بین فی حادی عشر الاصول پس خط سمت قبله وسمت وظل مقیاس بر یکدیگر منطبق
lines.en: As is explained in the eleventh of the Principles. So the line of the direction of the Qibla and the direction and the shadow of the gnomon coincide with each other.

lines.text: باشد و هو المطلوب و در تقویم نام بعد از جدول جدول ساعات ثبت جدولی بیاورند و در
lines.en: and that is what is sought, and in the almanac, the name after the table of the table of hours, they bring a recorded table, and in

lines.text: انجا بازای هر روزی ساعات صبح مقدم بر انروز ساعات شفق بعد از انروز که تقریبا بحسب
lines.en: there, corresponding to each day, the hours of morning preceding that day, the hours of twilight after that day, which approximately according to

lines.text: المقدارند ثبت کنند بدورقم یکی ساعات و دویم دقیقه و مراد بساعت صبح زمان مابین
lines.en: amount, they record in two digits, one hours and the second minutes, and the meaning of the hour of morning is the time between

summary.headline: Prayer Times and Qibla Azimuth
summary.text: Discussion of prayer times in Sunni and Imami practice, followed by the geometric determination of the Qibla azimuth from the Sun’s altitude and the gnomon’s shadow. It introduces an almanac table recording morning and twilight hours for each day.
